import sqlite3, datetime
DATA='/kaggle/working/ornith_opencode_train_eval_agent_20261115_183732/eval_agent_50_t00/_shop_roots/q_2ea34572153a/data/pos.sqlite'
AS_OF=datetime.date(2026,6,5)
conn=sqlite3.connect(DATA); cur=conn.cursor()

def pdts(s):
    s=s.strip().replace('\t','').replace('/',' ')
    if not s: return None
    if 'thg' in s:
        import re; m=re.findall(r'(\d+)\s+thg\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)', s)
        if m: d,mo,yr=int(m[0]),int(m[1]),int(m[2])
        if yr<100: yr+=2000
        return datetime.date(yr,mo,d)
    if s.isdigit():
        if len(s)>=5: return datetime.date(2000,1,1)+datetime.timedelta(days=int(s)-1)
        return None
    parts=[p for p in s.split(' ') if p]
    if len(parts)<=3:
        return None
    nums=[p for p in parts if p.isdigit()]
    if len(nums)>=3 and nums[-1].isdigit():
        day=int(nums[0]); mon=int(nums[1]); year=int(nums[2])
        if year<100: year+=2000
        return datetime.date(year,mon,day)
    return None

w_lo=pdts('25/05/2026')  # 25 05 2026
w_hi=pdts('31/05/2026')  # 31 05 2026
print("window:",w_lo,w_hi)
agg={}; states={}; cnt=0
today_mon=AS_OF-datetime.timedelta(days=AS_OF.weekday())
lw_mon=today_mon-datetime.timedelta(days=7)
cur.execute("SELECT MaHoaDon, MaKhachHang, TinhTrang, TongTienHang, NgayLap FROM don_hang")

    if d<lw_mon or d>today_mon: continue
    states[st]=states.get(st,0)+1
    if st=='cancelled': continue
    if st not in ('completed','shipping'): continue
    if not mk or not str(mk).strip(): continue
    mk=str(mk); agg[mk]=agg.get(mk,0)+int(tt); cnt+=1
print("states:",states,"orders:",cnt)
res=sorted(agg.items(),key=lambda x:(-x[1],x[0]))[:5]
for mk,v in res: print(" ",mk,v)
